Analyst notes
Headline
The quarter closed firmer than the spring tape suggested. Median pricing moved up, days on market compressed across the mid band, and Lakeside Commons reset its own ceiling twice.
Inventory
Active count remains 11% below the year-ago figure. We expect a modest October bump — eleven sellers we've spoken with are timing listings for the first two weeks of the month.
Watch
Westmoor softening: the only neighborhood with negative YoY price movement and a sale-to-list ratio under 97%. Worth a targeted CMA outreach to owners over 60 months tenure.
Recommendation
Re-price the three Q2 carry-overs (Birch Lane, Aspen Court, 14th & Sumac) before Oct 18; staging refresh on the two listings sitting above 45 days.
